notes.title: Estiman: back on the Steam store
notes.notes:
[p]EDIT: Happy to announce the takedown was just temporary. The game is back on Steam store!

original post, for reference:

Hello!

We'd like to share with you an important update regarding Estiman as the game [b]will be removed from Steam on March 19[/b].

Everyone who purchased it will still have access to it from the games library. The same goes for those who decide to buy the game in the coming days - prior to March 19.

Estiman is purely a single-player experience and due to our actions, you won't lose access to any major features. 

Sorry for the inconvenience!
[/p]

notes.title: Check our newest game - Uragun!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26948525/1afea8837965f4bcf84e8657e6ad83ac5efdc474.jpg[/img]

Yeah! We are back with the successfully Greenlited idea - [b]URAGUN[/b]!

This is a top-down shooter, which puts you in an all-powerful mech unit fighting with annihilating swarms of smart AI bots flooding the streets of London, New York, Moscow, Bejing and other cities! Game is designed by one of the Bulletstorm creators! And that's not the end of the exciting news we've got for you!

[b]Wishlist it now on Steam to get weekly updates on development![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/724000/Uragun/

notes.title: ESTIMAN got bling in its Valentine’s Day new special play mode
notes.notes:
Love is in  the air! Estiman is now filled with shiny, glittery Valentine’s Day bling thanks to a new special play mode. Our addictive estimation-based arcade visual puzzle game, which puts you in a relaxed state of mind by tapping into your intuitive skills, now comes with a limitless supply of shiny, heart-shaped crystals. Try it out now, and set the mood for luvin’!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26948525/04d90752797470f767f038352e5ae2d54907f325.jpg[/img]
